title.narrative: Contribution à la réduction de l’impact d’humanitaire de la sécheresse sur les personnes vulnérables au Niger. Action – Anticipatoire – 2022

description.narrative: The objective of this $2.25m UNICEF project is to reduce drought impact on vulnerable population through a multisectoral package including WASH, nutrition and education. To that end, UNICEF will rehabilitate seven water sources, distribute 5,195 WASH kits and share information on hygiene and water use practices. In addition, UNICEF will screen 15,000 children for malnutrition, treat 3,640 children with severe acute malnutrition, train 7,000 caregivers on nutrition screening, provide 7,239 children with nutritious supplements and counsel 11,000 pregnant or lactating women on best feeding practices. Moreover, UNICEF will provide cash transfers of $35 per household to families with school-aged children to ensure return to schools. In total, 36,363 persons including 7,789 women and 10,756 girls, will be reached with water and hygiene assistance. The nutrition component aims to reach 42,554 people, including 15,033 women and 9,797 girls. And the education component aims to reach 10,023 children.
